editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: Fission-AI/OpenSpec
items.summary: OpenSpec standardizes the spec-driven development process for AI-powered coding assistants. By defining technical requirements in software projects, it enables the AI to produce more consistent and error-free code.

items.title: ankitects/anki
items.summary: Anki is a flashcard software that facilitates learning using a spaced repetition algorithm. Developed in the Rust language, this open-source tool helps users transfer complex information into long-term memory.

items.title: supermemoryai/supermemory
items.summary: Supermemory is a context engine that allows users to store their digital content and query it with AI. By offering the ability to store and process data locally, it creates a scalable memory infrastructure for AI applications.

items.title: tradesdontlie/tradingview-mcp
items.summary: TradingView-mcp automates technical analysis processes by connecting the financial charting platform TradingView with the AI assistant Claude Code. This integration standardizes how users analyze market data and manage trading workflows.

items.title: rustfs/rustfs
items.summary: RustFS has been developed as a high-performance S3-compatible object storage system. It offers interoperability and data migration support with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.

items.title: supabase/supabase
items.summary: Supabase is a development platform based on PostgreSQL, a relational database management system for web and mobile applications. It provides a backend service that accelerates application development processes without the need for traditional database setup.

items.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram
items.summary: Gitdiagram is a tool that visualizes complex file structures and code relationships in GitHub repositories. It creates interactive diagrams that make it easier to understand the architecture of software projects.

items.title: Android 17 is the first since 3.x to add new APIs without releasing to the AOSP
items.summary: With the Android 17 release, Google is making new application programming interfaces (APIs) available without first releasing them through the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). This strategic shift changes the tradition of sharing source code publicly for operating system developments.

items.title: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels
items.summary: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels is a tunneling tool that exposes local servers to the internet without requiring any configuration. This service, which allows developers to securely expose their local projects (localhost) to the outside world, provides quick access without dealing with complex network settings.

items.title: OpenJev
items.summary: OpenJev is an open-source monitoring tool that tracks the performance of Java applications. It assists software developers in debugging and optimization processes by visualizing system resources and application metrics.

items.title: How to Write with an LLM
items.summary: When generating text with large language models, positioning the AI as an assistant that creates drafts or performs edits rather than as a writer increases productivity. Users achieve more original results when they guide the process by structuring their own ideas instead of having the AI write the text directly.

items.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM
items.summary: Cloudflare has managed to reduce the amount of memory used in its content delivery network (CDN) infrastructure by 100 terabytes through mathematical optimizations and data compression techniques. This method improves hardware efficiency by lowering memory usage on high-traffic servers.

items.title: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf
items.summary: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B, developed by Prism-ml, is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. The model uses a ternary quantization method to run a high-parameter structure with lower memory consumption.

items.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
items.summary: Fuse is a multi-agent simulation framework developed to measure the reasoning skills of large language models regarding social situations. This system aims to test the social inferences of artificial intelligence in verifiable structures based on user narratives.

items.title: Self-Evolving Search Index
items.summary: A self-evolving search index dynamically optimizes document representations in the information retrieval processes of large language models. Unlike static indexing strategies, this method aims to improve search quality by adapting to different information retrieval environments.

items.title: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
items.summary: Test-time scaling in large language models is directly related not only to the number of candidate responses generated but also to the method by which these candidates are created. Research reveals that batch or sequential generation strategies affect the model's reasoning performance and energy consumption in different ways.

items.title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
items.summary: VākQA is a new benchmark dataset developed to evaluate conversational question-answering systems in the Telugu language. Containing 2,001 question-answer pairs across six different domains and 2.5 hours of audio recordings, this study aims to measure the accuracy of voice-based artificial intelligence models in underrepresented languages.

items.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
items.summary: The ActObs method, used in reinforcement learning processes, increases training efficiency by enabling agents to predict not only their actions but also their environmental observations. This approach improves the exploration capabilities of agents by incorporating observation tokens into the supervised fine-tuning process.

items.title: Typst makes big strides
items.summary: Typst is a next-generation typesetting system that allows for the preparation of complex documents with a structure similar to coding. It facilitates document preparation processes by offering faster compilation times and a user-friendly syntax compared to traditional tools like LaTeX.

items.title: I don't like passkeys
items.summary: Passkeys are a security technology that provides device-based authentication, intended to replace traditional passwords. The authors argue that this system limits user experience due to device dependency and the complexity of backup processes.

items.title: There's no point at which turning your brain off will work
items.summary: The article written by Dan Luu discusses the risks of reducing mental effort or relying on automation in complex systems. It argues that completely disabling attention in technical processes leads to unexpected problems in critical areas such as debugging and system management.

glossary.explanation: Artificial intelligence models trained on massive data that can understand human language and generate text.
A development method that defines how the system will work with detailed rules before starting to write code.
A learning technique that ensures information is repeated at specific intervals to prevent it from being forgotten.
A system that provides past conversations and current information to artificial intelligence so it can give more accurate answers.
A large-scale storage method that stores data with unique identifiers instead of a file hierarchy.
The background part of the software that the user does not see, where data is processed and runs on the server.
An interface that acts as a bridge, allowing two different software programs to exchange data with each other.
The open-source version of the operating system used on smartphones.
The state of software running only on the computer currently in use, without connecting to the internet.
Software that continuously monitors whether systems are functioning correctly and provides alerts in case of errors.
